name: io.github.tokenverdict/token-audit
title: TokenVerdict — Token Risk Audit
description: Token risk verdict per contract: honeypot, buy/sell tax, liquidity. $0.02 per call, USDC via x402.

tools.name: audit_token
tools.description: Token risk verdict for one contract: honeypot check, buy and sell tax, liquidity, holder concentration. Returns PASS, CAUTION or REJECT with the underlying numbers. Paid tool: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 per call. Call without a payment header returns HTTP 402 with the payment requirements; retry the same JSON-RPC request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to pay.

tools.name: smart_money
tools.description: Smart-money snapshot for one contract: smart-money and KOL holder counts and share, bundler and new-wallet share, buy and sell flow over 1h and 24h with net direction. Paid tool: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 per call. Call without a payment header returns HTTP 402 with the payment requirements; retry the same JSON-RPC request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to pay.
